safe.title: Safe pressure: the nuisance line
safe.disclaimer: This is information, not legal advice.
safe.ladder: Pushing to the limit means using every rung: internal review = a second person at the body checks; ICO = the regulator checks; tribunal = a judge checks. Each is a lawful "are you sure?" that cannot be called a repeat request.
checklist: Never repeat a request that has been answered; escalate the answer instead.
Escalate by the formal route (internal review, ICO, tribunal, ombudsman) rather than asking again.
Polite, factual tone; no opinions about staff.
Write to the body's official address; never copy in individuals personally.
Respect the stated deadline before chasing.
Keep each request clearly in the public interest and tied to the record it seeks.

limits.name: FOIA s.14(1) · vexatious
limits.text: A body need not comply with a vexatious request. Dransfield [2015] EWCA Civ 454 is the leading case and the ICO has guidance (both not re-read this run).

limits.name: FOIA s.14(2) · repeated
limits.text: No duty to answer an identical or substantially similar request from the same person until a reasonable interval has passed.

limits.name: UK GDPR Art 12(5) · DPA 2018 s.53
limits.text: A manifestly unfounded or excessive subject access request (in particular a repetitive one) may be refused or charged for.

limits.name: Protection from Harassment Act 1997 s.1 and s.7
limits.text: A course of conduct (two or more occasions) amounting to harassment is unlawful; s.1(1A) covers pressing several people to make someone act; s.1(3)(b) protects conduct pursued under an enactment, i.e. the formal statutory routes.

limits.name: Anti-social Behaviour, Crime and Policing Act 2014 Part 1
limits.text: Civil injunctions for anti-social behaviour (s.1; meaning in s.2).

limits.name: Unacceptable-behaviour policies
limits.text: Most public bodies and ombudsmen have an unreasonable-persistence policy that can limit contact to one channel or one officer (each body's own policy; not checked this run).

inbound_only: Mail received from institutions only; outbound emails are not shown. Request dates and deadlines stay.
